sre-bot: ALERT resolved — incident 1749988000: Increased 5xx rate on /v1/generate (hosted) · paged at 1749986300 · resolved at 1749987800 · severity: P1-ish · link: https://redwood.internal/incidents/1749988000

maria (oncall): quick mitigation summary — scaled up dedicated pool + forced traffic to fallback model variant, invalidated a bad prefix cache. errors dropped to baseline at ~1749987800. no deploy during the window.

kevin (sre): confirmed. error spike correlated with autoscaler failing to spin up new nodes on GPU pool A. some retries piled up causing downstream 502s.

jonathan (infra): digging into the autoscaler — saw two failed instance launches with grpc timeout to cloud provisioner. opening a follow-up ticket for provider flakiness.

lena (pm): we need a postmortem + customer-impact estimate. who can own writing the RCA?

maria (oncall): i can assemble the mitigation timeline, but need infra to own root cause writeup. jonathan?

jonathan (infra): I'll own the RCA draft. plan: timeline, contributing factors (autoscaler + cache state), mitigation steps, action items. aiming for first draft EOD tomorrow (1740074400).

kevin (sre): i'll pull traces, p99/p50 latencies, and the error logs. attaching quick snippet here:```
[2026-03-15T09:12:03Z] ERROR gateway: upstream 502 from node-7: connect timeout
[2026-03-15T09:12:07Z] WARN autoscaler: launch failure: grpc deadline exceeded
```

lena (pm): action owners requested:
- RCA draft: jonathan
- Evidence pack (logs/traces/flamegraphs): kevin
- Customer impact + comms: lena
- Legal review for contractual impact: carla
- Postmortem review & signoff: maria + eng leads

carla (legal): will check SLA clauses and advise on credits if affected customers exceed thresholds. please include list of customers with >5% error for >= 5 minutes.

maria (oncall): i've uploaded mitigation notes and the raw alert stream here: https://redwood.internal/incidents/1749988000/logs — includes the oncall timeline and commands run.

jonathan (infra): question for infra/sre — do we have a persistent root cause (provider flakiness) or is there a config twitch on our side? kevin — any evidence of misconfiguration?

kevin (sre): preliminary: provider grpc timeout is the proximate cause. autoscaler retries were set low (2) for that pool; increasing to 5 would have likely avoided the spike. will confirm in traces.

jonathan (infra): ok will include that as contributing factor: conservative retry policy + provider transient failures.

lena (pm): timeline for peer review / signoff? propose draft in 24h, review window 48h, final signoff end of week. shippable action items should be tracked in a short ticket list.

maria (oncall): +1 on timeline. please add a remediation task to: (1) bump autoscaler retry limit, (2) improve alerting to detect repeated launch failures earlier, (3) add a short circuit to fallback model earlier.

jonathan (infra): i'll open the infra tickets after draft where applicable. tag: infra/autoscaler.

kevin (sre): i'll attach a condensed evidence bundle to the doc: p99 charts, request count, error-rate heatmap, and the raw instance launch logs.

carla (legal): loop me in the draft once you have customer list and impact numbers. I'll advise on wording for any credits or disclosures.

jonathan (infra): drafting now — starting the RCA doc at https://docs.redwood.internal/postmortems/1749988000-rca-draft — will ping when ready for review.

lena (pm): cc'ing support: need a list of API keys/customer accounts impacted for comms. if anyone sees a customer with a support ticket already, drop it in this thread.

maria (oncall): noted one partner on slack DM'd outages — adding to the customer list.

- attach flamegraphs + traces (kevin)
- bump autoscaler retries in staging and run soak (jonathan)
- update alert runbook to include launch-failure escalation (maria)
- customer impact spreadsheet (lena)

lena (pm): looping @samir from eng-runtime to review once draft is up.
